stem: The French Senate has passed a bill to

options.text: regulate digital services platforms.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 偷换概念】法案是征税（impose a tax），非出台平台日常运营监管法规（regulate）。

options.text: impose a levy on tech multinationals.
options.analysis: 【正确项 · 原文同义复现】P1-S1 和 P1-S3 明确指出法案的核心要旨：'passed a digital services tax, which would impose an entirely new tax on large multinationals... primarily to Google, Apple, Facebook and Amazon'（通过数字服务税，对提供数字化服务的大型跨国巨头征收新税，主要针对 GAFA 等科技跨国公司）。impose a levy on tech multinationals（对跨国科技巨头征税）与原文完全精准吻合（levy 即 tax）。

options.text: protect French companies' interests.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 偏离法案内容】核心在于开辟数字税源并解决跨国避税，非单纯保护本土企业。

options.text: curb the influence of advertising.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 局部征税对象】定向广告是征税收入来源之一，非抑制广告影响。

methodologyReview.trapAnalysis: impose entirely new tax on large multinationals (Google, Apple, Facebook, Amazon) = impose a levy on tech multinationals。
methodologyReview.methodSummary: 首段题眼同义改写：impose a tax on tech multinationals 转换为 impose a levy on tech multinationals。

stemKeywords: French Senate has passed a bill to

stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 2 that the digital services tax

options.text: will prompt the tech giants to quit France.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 夸大后果】巨头不会轻易放弃庞大的法国市场，文章未提及退出法国。

options.text: aims to ease international trade tensions.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 事实相反】该法案直接加剧了美法之间的贸易紧张摩擦，绝非缓和局势（ease）。

options.text: is apt to arouse criticism at home and abroad.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 国内外混淆】国内政界和总统均大力支持（Macron expressed support），批评反弹主要来自美国政府和企业。

options.text: may trigger countermeasures against France.
options.analysis: 【正确项 · 同义替换】P2-S2 明确指出该税项招致的后果：'with the United States trade representative opening an investigation... which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against France'（美国贸易代表已启动调查，这进而可能导致对法国实施贸易制裁）。A选项 may trigger countermeasures against France（可能引发针对法国的反制措施/制裁）是对 lead to trade sanctions against France 最精准的同义改写。

methodologyReview.trapAnalysis: could lead to trade sanctions against France = may trigger countermeasures against France。
methodologyReview.methodSummary: 反制制裁细节题：trade sanctions against France 转换为 countermeasures against France。

stem: The countries adopting the unilateral measures share the opinion that

options.text: the current international tax system needs upgrading.
options.analysis: 【正确项 · 同义替换】P4-S1 明确阐述各国采取单边行动的共同根源：'they all share a view that the international tax system has failed to keep up with the current economy'（它们都普遍持有同一观点：现行国际税收体系已经严重跟不上当代数字经济的发展）。B选项 the current international tax system needs upgrading（现行的国际税收体系需要升级重塑）是对 failed to keep up with current economy 最完美的同义转述。

options.text: redistribution of tech giants' revenue must be ensured.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 偷换概念】焦点在于对跨国数字收入确立合法征税权，非财富二次再分配。

options.text: tech multinationals' monopoly should be prevented.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 混淆反垄断与税收】各国立法旨在解决税收流失与征税权，非反垄断拆分。

options.text: all countries ought to enjoy equal taxing rights.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 抽象概念】核心在于适应数字经济新现实，非要求绝对均等的税收权。

methodologyReview.trapAnalysis: share a view that international tax system has failed to keep up with current economy = current international tax system needs upgrading。
methodologyReview.methodSummary: 共识观点原句提取：failed to keep up with economy 转换为 needs upgrading。

stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 5 that the OECD's current work

options.text: is being resisted by US companies.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 偷换对象】美企抵制的是法国等国的单边数字税，美法两国政府均在参与 OECD 的多边协商。

options.text: is faced with uncertain prospects.
options.analysis: 【正确项 · 合理推断】P5-S1 明确描述 OECD 工作的严峻现实：尽管 OECD 正努力在131国间达成国际共识，但'France's digital services tax and the American response raise questions about what the future holds for the international tax system'（法国的单边开征与美方的激烈反弹，给国际税收体系的未来走向打上了巨大问号）。raise questions about what future holds 意为“使未来走向充满疑云与变数”，精准对应 C 选项 is faced with uncertain prospects（正面临着极不确定的前景）。

options.text: needs to be readjusted immediately.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 无中生有】OECD 正在按照原计划推进2020年底共识，未提及立即重新调整其工作路线。

options.text: needs to involve more countries.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 数量充足】已经有131个国家深度参与其中（working with 131 countries），国家数量极为庞大充足。

methodologyReview.trapAnalysis: raise questions about what the future holds = is faced with uncertain prospects（面临不确定的前景）。
methodologyReview.methodSummary: 习语推断法：raise questions about what the future holds 对应 is faced with uncertain prospects。

stem: Which of the following might be the best title for this text?

options.text: France Leads the Charge on Digital Tax.
options.analysis: 【正确项 · 全文主旨概括】全文通篇以法国率先立法开征数字服务税（GAFA 税）为核心主角与贯穿全篇的焦点脉络（P1-2），随后深入指出法国此举正是领衔带动全球多国单边税收立法浪潮（P3-4）、倒逼 OECD 加速国际税制重塑并向全球发出警示信号的领头羊行动（P5-6）。B选项 France Leads the Charge on Digital Tax（法国领衔打响数字税冲锋战）以极其生动精炼的笔触统领全文的核心事件与引领地位，为最佳标题。

options.text: France Is Confronted with Trade Sanctions.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 局部细节】贸易制裁仅为第二段提到的美方潜在反击，未能统领全文关于全球税改大势与 OECD 谈判的核心主线。

options.text: France Demands a Role in the Digital Economy.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 偏离税改核心】法国争夺的是数字时代的税收管辖权（taxing rights），非争夺数字产业角色。

options.text: France Says "No" to Tech Multinationals.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 概念偏差】法国并不是拒绝或赶走跨国科技巨头，而是依法要求其对数字服务收入缴纳合理税款。

methodologyReview.trapAnalysis: France passes digital services tax + part of larger trend + clear warning / follow suit = France Leads the Charge on Digital Tax。
methodologyReview.methodSummary: 主旨标题题核心事件提取：抓住核心主角（France）与核心行动（Leads the Charge on Digital Tax）。
